counting_rules: Count distinct source papers only after independent source review, canonical integration, website QA, successful deployment and anonymous live verification.
Record inherited pretrial extraction/audit work separately from cold-start papers.
Variants and multiple supporting documents do not multiply the source-paper count; preserve variant record/sample identity.
Drafts, corrections to existing sources, progress releases and unresolved holds never count as new completed papers.
Use elapsed wall time including setup, failures and rework; also record per-stage active worker time.
